notes.title: v1.0.8 Patch Notes and BIG Thank You!
notes.content:
Just wanted to say, WOW guys. It is extremely humbling to see how this game is being received all over social media. I wanted to say thank you to everyone for all of the support and I hope I can continue to bring the spoops for many midNIGHTS to come ;)

v1.0.8 Patch Notes

Fixed two null reference errors regarding level replaying.

Modified Gamma Correction handling. For current owners, you will have to adjust your gamma. This was done after seeing quite a few people playing with gamma that was far past the value it should have been.
